_comment: FROZEN. Do not edit to make a red test green — find out what diverged. This fixture owns its config so balance tuning cannot silently change the expected hash. The hash legitimately changed once, at step 4, when towers began shooting: the match itself is different, not the arithmetic.
_coverage: At these values the match kills 7 creeps and leaves 5 alive having each completed 2 laps — so one fixture exercises death, survival, looping and damage persisting across laps. Chosen deliberately: at hp=100 towers killed everything before any creep lapped, and the loop mechanic went untested.
